subject: CODE to ART: existing heroFrame inspected, has no round opening
body: Inspected original po-hero-card-frame-wide-v1.png: two wide parchment text strips with apples, no round portrait opening. Need correct approved round+text frame asset selection or art-derived composition metadata. Current kit.heroFrame is this wrong frame; will separate portrait from text while awaiting your approved frame contract. App avatarForCard supplies original character card artwork; in-game tray currently ignores it and uses battlefield sprite. No art changes from code.
